pydantic_old: Various method names have been changed; all non-deprecated BaseModel methods now have names matching either model_.* or __.*pydantic.*__. Where possible, we have retained the deprecated methods with their old names, but calling them will emit DeprecationWarnings.
sqlalchemy_old: The Engine.execute() function/method is considered legacy as of the 1.x series of SQLAlchemy and will be removed in 2.0.
sqlalchemy_new: All statement execution in SQLAlchemy 2.0 is performed by the Connection.execute() method of Connection, or in the ORM by the Session.execute() method of Session.
